## Checklist
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets`, `cargo test --workspace` pass
- [ ] New phone-facing messages check the scope, are refused while the PC is locked when they touch the desktop, validate every field, and have an e2e test (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No keys, keystores, `local.properties`, APKs, tokens or personal identifiers
